ambience_notes: early morning light, low sun over the ridge, frost in the shade, birdsong through the cab window (suggested sfx id: mychief-morning-birds-loop, not yet made)

characters.BOSS: D. Marsh, supervisor, Kettle Fork Ranger Station, callsign Kettle Base
characters.PLAYER: Fire lookout, callsign Unit Four, silent protagonist with 3 short lines

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: Kettle Base to Unit Four. Good morning. Radio check. You still with me?

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: Good. Road gets rough past Hale Creek, so take it slow. Sun's barely up and there's ice in the shade.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: You'll be at Mount Elgo Tower in about ten minutes. Early start, but you'll want the day to settle in. Best view in Tamarack National Forest.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: Your job's simple. You watch. Any smoke, any glow, you get on this radio and report it. Bearing and distance.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Copy. Smoke or fire, I report it.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: One rule, and I need you to hear it. Never leave the tower. Whatever you hear down there, you stay up top.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: There's a nine millimeter in the cab. That's for protection, not for hunting. Fifty rounds, so make them count.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: Road's about to flatten out. That's the lot ahead. Park it and head on up.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: Tower's all yours. I'll check in after dark. Kettle Base out.

sfx.note: loop, fade to idle at arrive_lot
loop, plays between arrive_lot and engine_off
